Mara: Heads-up — p99 jumped to ~1.6s for several text-gen routes after last night's autoscale event. Tail aligns with scale-up windows, not steady-state. Anyone tracking correlation with KV misses or kernel swaps?

Josh: saw it too. timeline: autoscaler added nodes at 23:45 UTC, then a 60–90s tail that pushed p99 up. Heatmap shows a cluster of cold KV misses + a kernel fallback from fastpath->safe kernel.

Nikita: adding data: our perf traces show KV-miss ratio went from 3% -> 28% right after scale. That explains extra ~200–400ms per request. Also batch sizes briefly halved during the spike (microbatch target dropped).

Thom: quick theory: prober sampling + new nodes = cold KV + kernel selector not warmed for fp16 fast kernel, so requests hit safe kernel with larger latency. We should confirm prober cadence and probe distribution.

Mara: logs snippet from one node around scale up:
```
[23:46:12] KVCache: miss key_count=312 seq=64 route=/chat/gpt-like
[23:46:12] KernelSelector: chose kernel=fastpath_fp16 score=-inf -> fallback safe_fp32
[23:46:13] Latency: 1.42s p99 sample id=xyz
```

Josh: profiling excerpt (top call stacks aggregated):
```
  38%  kv_lookup
  22%  kernel_dispatch_safe
  14%  batch_monter
  10%  rpc_wait
```

Nikita: proposed mitigations:
- increase prober replication to 3x during scale-up windows
- run KV prewarm task on newly provisioned nodes (cheap async warm-peek)
- reduce microbatch target from 8 -> 4 for routes with avg seq <=512 to reduce queuing jitter

Thom: agree on prewarm. simple kickoff command I used in dev cluster:
```sh
# trigger lightweight prewarm for node pool
curl -X POST https://internal-api/prewarm -d '{"pool":"scaleup-2026","routes":["/chat/*"]}'
```
Make sure prober respects locality so we don't hammer remote pools.

dev-bot: Deploy bot: rollout 2026-03-17T23:45Z id=deploy-5632 user=infra-cd triggered autoscale event for pool scaleup-2026.

ops-bot: Alert: 23:45–23:48 elevated KV miss rate detected (threshold 10% breached). Auto-remediation skipped (opt-in).

Josh: incremental runtime changes we can try (canary):
1) kernel selector tweak: prefer fastpath_fp16 for seq<=256, fallback hill-climb over 10s rather than immediate fallback.
2) microbatch knob: set target=4 for canary routes, observe p95/p99 and tokens/sec.
3) prober tune: double probe rate for first 2 min after node spin-up.

Nikita: tradeoffs note — reducing microbatch hurts throughput; expect ~12–18% throughput loss but can cut p99 by ~300–500ms on bursty traffic. Need to measure cost impact.

Mara: action items:
- Thom to add prewarm endpoint + low-cost warm-peek script (ETA today)
- Josh to prepare kernel selector canary (5% traffic) + dashboard to compare p95/p99 vs tokens/sec (ETA tomorrow)
- Nikita to run cost vs latency sim based on reduced microbatch (small A/B) (ETA tomorrow)
- Ops to enable ephemeral prober amplification during autoscale windows (config change)

Thom: I'll push a small prewarm job and share command. will also add a safeguard to avoid double-prewarm across regions.

Mara: Thanks — let's reconvene after the canary runs. Please paste dashboards in thread so we can decide next steps. :thumbsup:
